note: Built by tools/shaders/review/fetch_feedback.py from GitHub issues; the latest response is last.

golden.note: This is in a good spot, but we can always do better.

leaves.note: I agree with the critic. I just expect more cinematic light.

water-sunset.note: This is a really good starting platform and I hope that this isn't the best quality that we can produce because I am hoping to get more beauty out of a scene like this.

night-new.note: I think the lighting profile is right, but I would like to give the sky a little more texture and beauty to it. We should introduce a rotation of skies so that it doesn't get too samey.

torch.note: Warmer was definitely the right call.

hills.note: I kind of like the haze off to the left where the elevation drops, but I don't like that it washes out the color of everything at the same elevation as the camera.

water-biomes.note: The critic is right on the fucking money again.

flecks.note: Do like 125% of whichever of these has more.

water-direction.note: I would like a combination of complementary's unbound (realistic) style, and photons strict realism. I really like the screenshots from those 2 the best.

clouds.note: This one looks much better, but is only good with the right execution. I don't want it to look like a png of this pasted onto the sky. I would want something more dynamic that looks beautiful and natural. I want this pack to have a truly beautiful sky.

texture-pack.note: A combination of A and C. We use faithful as a base, and get broad range of other packs to look for inspiration and references from.

answers.overall: I feel like this is beginning to take shape, and I am really eager to get this to a really polished product. It would help to be able to add reverence images to this form. Like if I could screen grab on my Mac, and just drag and drop it in to the form to send over.
